welcome.tip.save.title: Save the active file
welcome.tip.save.description: Saves with its encoding and line ending. The shortcut can be changed in Settings → Shortcuts.
welcome.tip.palette.title: Command palette
welcome.tip.palette.description: Everything the IDE can do, by name. Also from the ☰ menu in the title bar.
welcome.tip.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts your way
welcome.tip.shortcuts.description: In Settings → Shortcuts pick a keymap (Scrakk, VS Code or JetBrains) or import your keybindings.json.
welcome.tip.terminal.title: Integrated terminal
welcome.tip.terminal.description: Open the project terminal without leaving the editor; drag between terminals to join them on the canvas.
welcome.tip.new-terminal.title: New terminal
welcome.tip.new-terminal.description: Add another terminal to the canvas and switch between them without losing the file you are editing.
welcome.tip.chat.title: AI chat
welcome.tip.chat.description: Ask about the open file. The tools (search, edit, draw on a canvas) are just more commands.
welcome.tip.explorer.title: Explorer
welcome.tip.explorer.description: Workspace files: create, rename and delete from the context menu, with multi-select.
welcome.tip.split.title: Split the editor
welcome.tip.split.description: Drag a tab to the edge of the editor area to work with two files side by side.
welcome.tip.problems.title: Problems and diagnostics
welcome.tip.problems.description: LSP errors grouped by file, updated as you type.
welcome.tip.themes.title: Light or dark theme
welcome.tip.themes.description: Switch between light and dark instantly; Settings → Appearance has all of them, store themes included.
